job_id.Description: The `job-{YYMMDD}{hash}` directory name of the capsule. A `-2`, `-3` counter is appended when one logical job forms a second capsule on the same day.

dandiset_id.Description: The six-digit Dandiset the source asset belongs to.

within_dandiset_path.Description: The source asset's path within its Dandiset.

pipeline.Description: The pipeline that formed this capsule, such as "aind+ephys" or "lfp".

version.Description: The pipeline release the capsule was prepared against, such as `v1.2.2`. The leading `v` is optional, a release need not carry three parts, and a pre-release or build suffix may follow, as in `v1.0.0-fixes` or `v1.1.1+b268fd2+a66c8df`.

params.Description: The registered parameter set key the capsule was formed with.

config.Description: The registered SLURM configuration key the capsule was formed with. Pipelines with no configuration of their own record a placeholder here rather than omitting it.

codebase.Description: The version of this repository that formed the capsule. Deliberately excluded from a capsule's identity, since a capsule is the same logical job regardless of which codebase version produced it. Reads `unknown` when the package is running from a source tree with no installed distribution to report a version.

content_id.Description: The source asset's DANDI content identifier. Null when the capsule's upstream source could not be resolved, which is recorded rather than guessed at.

asset_size_bytes.Description: The source asset's size in bytes, or null alongside an unresolved content_id.

status.Description: Where this capsule has reached in its lifecycle.

Levels.pending: A code directory exists, but the capsule has not been submitted.
Levels.stalled: A submitted marker exists, but nothing has been logged since.
Levels.failed: Logs exist without output. This covers both a run still in progress and a run that failed, because nothing recorded about a capsule tells the two apart.
Levels.unknown: Nothing that would place the capsule in the lifecycle was observed. Also the fallback for a status cell that is empty or unrecognised.

created_at.Description: When the capsule was formed, taken from its submission script. An ISO 8601 timestamp, treated as UTC when it carries no offset.

job_submission_time.Description: When the job left the queue, taken from the earliest submitted marker. A capsule may carry several markers after a resubmission, so the earliest is the one used.

job_completion_time.Description: When the job last wrote a log. Null for a capsule that has not run.

queue_wait_seconds.Description: Whole seconds between `created_at` and `job_submission_time`. Derived rather than stored, so it is written to the jobs table but ignored when one is read back.

run_duration_seconds.Description: Whole seconds between `job_submission_time` and `job_completion_time`. Derived on the same terms as `queue_wait_seconds`.

process_wall_time_seconds.Description: Whole seconds summed over the duration of every process in the capsule's Nextflow `logs/timeline.html`. Processes can run side by side, so this is compute time rather than elapsed time. Read only when the jobs table is refreshed, and null for a capsule with no readable timeline, such as one that has not run or a pipeline without Nextflow.
